subject: Mythology
title: The Ramayana: Rama's Quest
description: One-minute skill: The Ramayana: Rama's Quest.

hook.text: The Ramayana is one of the longest poems ever written, telling how Prince Rama rescued his wife from a demon king.

buildup.text: Rama was exiled from his kingdom for fourteen years. During his forest exile, the demon Ravana kidnapped Sita.

discovery.text: With Hanuman's help, Rama built a bridge across the ocean and led an army of monkeys and bears against Lanka.

twist.text: Ravana had ten heads and was nearly invincible. Rama had to use a divine weapon given by the gods to defeat him.

climax.text: Rama's return to his kingdom is celebrated as Diwali, when millions light lamps to mark his triumphant homecoming.

punchline.text: One love story lit a billion lamps.

quiz.question: What event from the Ramayana is celebrated as Diwali?
options: Rama's triumphant return to his kingdom after defeating Ravana
The birth of Rama as an avatar of Vishnu
